```{r r0_samples}
# generate infection using H1N1 as a base
# this is the least transmissible infection for which {daedalus} has data
disease_x <- daedalus_infection(disease)
r0 <- get_data(disease_x, "r0")
r0_samples <- withr::with_seed(
  1, rbeta(n_samples, 2, 5)
) * r0 + 1.0
r0_samples <- round(r0_samples, 4)
r0_samples <- scales::rescale(r0_samples, c(1.0, 2))
r0_samples <- sort(r0_samples)

# R0 to use in phase 1 and 2
r0_phase_1 <- median(r0_samples)
r0_phase_2 <- quantile(r0_samples, 0.83)
```

```{r r0_summary}
# get 95% confidence intervals around R0
ci_95 <- ci(r0_samples)
r0_summary <- c(
  lower = median(r0_samples) - ci_95,
  median = median(r0_samples),
  upper = median(r0_samples) + ci_95
)
r0_summary <- round(r0_summary, 3)
```

```{r severity_profile}
# draw mortality profile so working and school age worst affected
severity_profile <- c(0.2, 1.5, 2, 0.2)

# apply severity profile
hfr <- get_data(disease_x, "hfr")
hfr <- mean(hfr) * severity_profile * 10
```

```{r infection_samples}
# make list of infection objects
disease_list <- Map(
  r0_samples,
  f = function(x, y) {
    daedalus_infection(
      "influenza_2009",
      r0 = x,
      hfr = hfr
    )
  }
)
disease_tags <- glue::glue("sample_{seq_along(disease_list)}")
```

```{r plot_r0}
plot_r0 <- ggplot() +
  stat_histinterval(
    aes(
      r0_samples, fill = after_stat(level)
    ),
    limits = c(0.5, 1.0)
  ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(na.translate = FALSE) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme_eppi() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    ) +
      labs(
        x = "R0", y = "Density", fill = "Confidence interval"
      )
```

```{r}
death_reporting <- 0.9
case_reporting <- 0.33
hosp_reporting <- 0.9

response_levels <- c("none", "main", "alt")
```

```{r}
#### GET ALL OUTPUTS ####
# get epi curve data and prepare for plotting
data_epi_curve <- get_epicurve_data(output, disease_tags, format = "long")

# get reported values
data_epi_curve <- mutate(
  data_epi_curve,
  reporting_rate = case_when(
    measure == "daily_deaths" ~ death_reporting,
    measure == "daily_infections" ~ case_reporting,
    measure == "daily_hospitalisations" ~ hosp_reporting,
    measure == "total_hosp" ~ hosp_reporting
  ),
  reported_value = value * reporting_rate,
  response = forcats::as_factor(
    response
  )
)

data_epi_curve_summary <- group_by(
  data_epi_curve, time, response, measure
) %>%
  curve_interval(
    value, reported_value,
    .width = c(0.5, 0.95)
  )
```


```{r}
# get losses data
data_cost_output <- get_cost_data(output, disease_tags, format = "long") %>%
  filter(domain != "life_years") %>%
  mutate(
    response = forcats::as_factor(
      response
    )
  )

# separate economic losses into closures and absences
data_econ_costs <- get_econ_cost_data(output)
data_econ_cost_closures <- filter(
  data_econ_costs, cost_type == "economic_cost_closures"
) %>%
  mutate(
    response = forcats::as_factor(
      response
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  summarise(cost = median(cost))

data_econ_cost_absences <- filter(
  data_econ_costs, cost_type == "economic_cost_absences"
) %>%
  mutate(
    response = forcats::as_factor(
      response
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# set current day
day_zero <- 30
day_now <- 200
```

```{r}
# FIGURES: epi curves
measures <- c(
  "daily_infections", "daily_hospitalisations",
  "total_hosp", "daily_deaths"
)

curve_measure_labels <- c(
  daily_infections = "New detected cases",
  daily_hospitalisations = "New hospital demand",
  total_hosp = "Total hospital demand",
  daily_deaths = "New deaths"
)

response_labels <- c(
  none = "Unmitigated",
  main = "Chosen response",
  alt = "Alternative response"
)

plots_epi_curves <- Map(
  measures, curve_measure_labels,
  f = function(m, l) {
    plot_epi_curves <-
      ggplot() +
      # red area for response active
      annotate(
        geom = "rect",
        xmin = response_start, xmax = response_start + response_duration,
        ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = data_epi_curve %>%
          filter(measure == m),
        aes(time, reported_value, group = tag),
        alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.2
      ) +
      geom_lineribbon(
        data = data_epi_curve_summary %>%
          filter(measure == m),
        aes(time, reported_value,
          ymin = reported_value.lower, ymax = reported_value.upper
        ),
        col = "black",
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      facet_grid(
        cols = vars(response),
        labeller = labeller(
          response = response_labels
        )
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = day_now,
        col = "red", linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(
        begin = 0.1, direction = -1,
        labels = function(x) {
          scales::percent(as.numeric(x))
        }
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = scales::comma
      ) +
      xlim(day_zero, horizon) +
      labs(
        x = x_label_days,
        y = l,
        fill = "Proj. interv."
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 24, base_family = "Arial") +
      theme_eppi()

    if (m == "total_hosp") {
      plot_epi_curves <- plot_epi_curves +
        geom_hline(
          yintercept = hcap,
          col = "red", linetype = "dashed"
        )
    }

    plot_epi_curves
  }
)
```

<!-- ## Cumulative summary -->

```{r}
summary_measure_labels <- c(
  epidemic_size = "Cumulative detected cases",
  total_deaths = "Cumulative deaths"
)
```

```{r}
plot_epi_summary <- ggplot(
  data_epi_summary %>%
    filter(measure != "total_hospitalisations")
) +
  stat_interval(
    aes(
      y = reported_value,
      color = after_stat(
        level
      )
    ),
    .width = c(0.5, 0.95),
    linewidth = 30, alpha = 0.8,
    normalize = "groups"
  ) +
  stat_pointinterval(
    aes(y = reported_value),
    .width = c(0.5, 0.95)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(response),
    rows = vars(measure),
    labeller = labeller(
      measure = summary_measure_labels,
      response = response_labels
    ),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(
    begin = 0.1, direction = -1,
    labels = function(x) {
      scales::percent(as.numeric(x))
    }
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count",
    colour = "Proj. interv."
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 24, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme_eppi() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
plot_econ_losses <- ggplot(data_cost_output) +
  stat_interval(
    aes(
      x = response, y = cost,
      color = after_stat(
        level
      )
    ),
    .width = c(0.5, 0.95),
    linewidth = 30, alpha = 0.8,
    normalize = "groups"
  ) +
  stat_pointinterval(
    aes(response, cost),
    .width = c(0.5, 0.95),
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    facets = vars(domain),
    # rows = vars(measure),
    labeller = labeller(
      # measure = summary_measure_labels,
      domain = loss_measure_labels
    ),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = response_labels,
    guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_currency(
      scale = 0.7e-3, prefix = "£", suffix = " B"
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(
    begin = 0.1, direction = -1,
    labels = function(x) {
      scales::percent(as.numeric(x))
    }
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative value lost (billion £)",
    col = "Proj. interv."
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(24, "Arial") +
  theme_eppi()
```
